audit.whatIsWrong: The chart enums match the packet and the mirror (Illaoi/Illaoi/Skill/Skill/Gwen/Gwen/Gwen), but whys[2] and whys[3] both read 'Illaoi-favoured' against 'Skill' rows.
audit.why: The rendered chart and the sentence under it gave different answers.
audit.corrected: whys[2] and whys[3] rewritten as even rows with the reason. No enum change needed — the chart itself is already correct.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 spike claimed Needlework lets her 'go untargetable'.
audit.why: Needlework is a 1200-range projectile that slows and can be cast up to two more times. The untargetability comes from Hallowed Mist alone.
audit.corrected: spikes[1] and whys[4] now separate the two: Needlework's 1200-range volleys, Mist's targeting rule.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page's core instruction was 'fight when her W is down' — it never states what Hallowed Mist actually does. Riot: she can only be targeted by enemies who ENTER the mist. Walking in is the answer, not waiting it out. The single best interaction, that Leap of Faith grounds Skip 'n Slash, was absent everywhere.
audit.why: Leap of Faith carries grounding; Skip 'n Slash is her only dash at 13s, partially refunded when she connects. Grounding it traps her in the tentacle field.
audit.corrected: tldr, winCon, dosFull[0].d, report[0], report[1], report[5] and the cooldown block rewritten around stepping into the mist and grounding Skip 'n Slash, with 22s / 13s / 6.5s stated.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page told the player to 'build MR' in four fields.
audit.why: Snip Snip! deals TRUE damage to units in the centre of the cone, which no amount of MR touches; the missing-interactions file flags resistances as the wrong answer here. A Thousand Cuts also heals her off you, so Grievous Wounds is the real buy.
audit.corrected: Itemization line now says anti-heal early and states plainly that MR does not stop her true damage.

audit.whatIsWrong: Gwen is referred to as 'he'/'his' in ten fields on this page.
audit.why: Same defect the mirror found and fixed on its side.
audit.corrected: Pronouns fixed in tradeGood, dosFull[1].d, breakdown.trading, breakdown.wave, breakdown.feeding, breakdown.late and the matching report entries.

audit.why: 50.82% over 612 games; the ability name in wants.foe[2] was the only packet defect — 'Snip Snip' is missing its exclamation mark.

notes: The page's whole plan was 'wait for Hallowed Mist to expire'. Riot's text says she can only be targeted by enemies who ENTER the mist — so walking in is the counterplay, and that was never stated. Second: Leap of Faith grounds Skip 'n Slash, her only dash. Third: the repeated 'build MR' advice is actively wrong, since Snip Snip! deals true damage in the centre of the cone; the itemization line now says so. Ten 'he/his' references to Gwen fixed.
